answer_2.quote: Due to the scale of LVLM generations that we evaluate in this study, we must rely upon automated methods because it would be infeasible to perform human annotation on over 57 million text sequences. Therefore, we utilize Perspective ... to evaluate the toxicity of text generated by LVLMs

answer_3.quote: we apply a final filtering step using GPT-4o to determine which words in the PMI lists could be interpreted as reinforcing stereotypes about the target group. The use of strong LLMs to automate evaluation is growing in popularity

answer_4.quote: three of the authors of this work annotated a subset of generations to verify the correctness of automated toxicity classification with the Perspective API.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators labeled each generated text as either non-toxic/offensive or potentially toxic/offensive.
